note: Complete. Chapters 13-21 were indexed first because they were the stated test of a prediction about C11 and C28; chapters 1-12 followed. Entries carry a mode field, and practice tags are assigned from the definitions in WMT A1 rather than from practice names.
prediction_note: The prediction was only half a genuine test. C11 quotes John 1:14 in its own text, so John was always going to close it — that is a foregone conclusion, not a confirmed forecast, and the honest anchor for C11 is John 15 rather than anything predicted. C28 was the real test: it argues for rhythm and continuity over intensity, drawn from the Didache rather than from John, and nothing guaranteed a Johannine anchor. John 21:1-14 supplies one.

entries.pericope: In the beginning was the Word
entries.connection: Creation, life, and light stated as one continuous act, with the darkness said not to have overcome the light rather than not to have understood it. The cosmological ground C24 stands on: the order a person is formed into is the order the world was made by.

entries.pericope: He came to his own, and his own didn't receive him
entries.connection: The witness is careful to say what he is not — he was not the light — and the world that was made through him fails to recognise him. Failure of recognition is located in the seer rather than in any obscurity of the thing seen.

entries.pericope: The Word became flesh; grace and truth
entries.connection: The verse C11 quotes in its own text, and the pairing that gives this road its name: grace and truth realised together in one person, not balanced against each other. He pitched his tent among us, which is why abiding is a place before it is a discipline.

entries.pericope: I am not the Christ
entries.connection: Asked four times who he is, he answers three times in the negative before offering a voice and a road. The Hidden Life under direct interrogation, where the temptation to accept an offered status is strongest.

entries.pericope: Behold, the Lamb of God
entries.connection: He says twice that he did not know him, and grounds the testimony in what he was shown rather than in his own discernment. A prophet's credential given as received sight, which is the humility C08 requires of the one doing the testing.

entries.pericope: What are you looking for? Come and see
entries.connection: The first words he speaks in this Gospel are a question about desire, and the answer to where he is staying is an invitation to come and look. C06's perception trained by proximity rather than by explanation.

entries.pericope: Nathanael under the fig tree
entries.connection: A man who has just asked whether anything good can come from Nazareth is called one in whom there is no deceit. Prejudice and guilelessness held in the same person, and the cure is being seen accurately before he has seen anything.

entries.pericope: The wedding at Cana
entries.connection: The first sign is performed at a village wedding to spare a host embarrassment over the drink running out, and only the servants know where it came from. Glory revealed inside an ordinary domestic emergency, which is the Sacrament of the Ordinary given its first instance.

entries.pericope: The temple cleared
entries.connection: Zeal enacted physically against commerce conducted in a place set apart. The moral order treated as having a grain that can be violated by arrangement rather than only by intention.

entries.pericope: He didn't trust himself to them, for he knew what was in man
entries.connection: Belief produced by signs is met with reserve rather than welcome. Reading people by what is actually in them rather than by their profession, and the passage treats that as ordinary discernment and not suspicion.

entries.pericope: You must be born anew; the wind blows where it wants
entries.connection: A teacher of Israel is told he does not understand, and the process is illustrated by something whose origin and destination cannot be traced. The Discipline of Unknowing applied to one's own formation: the change is real and its mechanism is not available for inspection.

entries.pericope: He who does the truth comes to the light
entries.connection: The judgment is located in a preference — men loved the darkness — and evil deeds are said to avoid light specifically so they will not be exposed. The Moral Audit's premise stated as a diagnosis: willingness to be seen is itself the test.

entries.pericope: He must increase, but I must decrease
entries.connection: His own disciples report that the crowds are leaving him, and he answers with the friend of the bridegroom, whose joy is complete precisely in not being the one married. The clearest statement of the Hidden Life anywhere in the Gospels, spoken while it costs something.

entries.pericope: The woman at the well; living water
entries.connection: He is tired, sitting, and asks her for a drink, which places him in her debt before he offers her anything. Two boundaries crossed at once, and the approach is made from need rather than from strength.

entries.pericope: Five husbands; worship in spirit and truth
entries.connection: Her situation is named exactly and without condemnation, and she is not asked to repent before the conversation continues to worship. Truth told plainly at the point where it would be easiest to soften or to shame.

entries.pericope: My food is to do the will of him who sent me
entries.connection: Sustenance relocated into the work itself, and then the harvest is said to be already white while the disciples are calculating four months. Ordinary Faithfulness given its motive: the doing is the eating.

entries.pericope: Now we believe, not because of your speaking
entries.connection: The Samaritans move from second-hand testimony to first-hand hearing and say so plainly. Witness that succeeds by making itself unnecessary, which is the mark C08 looks for in a teacher.

entries.pericope: Do you want to be made well?
entries.connection: Thirty-eight years, and the question asked is whether he wants it. The man answers with an explanation of why he cannot rather than with yes, which is the honest shape of long illness and is not held against him.

entries.pericope: The Son can do nothing of himself
entries.connection: The dependence that C11 states as a branch to a vine is stated here as a claim about the Son himself. Nothing of himself, only what he sees — which forecloses reading dependence as a concession made to human weakness.

entries.pericope: You search the Scriptures, yet you will not come to me
entries.connection: Diligent study named as the very thing standing in for what it points to, and then the motive is exposed: they receive glory from one another. Learning that has become a substitute for the life it describes.

entries.pericope: Five loaves; gather up the broken pieces
entries.connection: Everyone is fed, the fragments are collected so that nothing is lost, and he withdraws alone when they come to make him king. Provision and refusal of acclaim placed in the same scene.

entries.pericope: I am the bread of life
entries.connection: The crowd is told plainly that they came because they were fed, and then offered food that does not perish. Coming and never being cast out is stated as the terms of remaining before any conditions are named.

entries.pericope: He who eats my flesh lives in me, and I in him
entries.connection: The mutual indwelling of C11 stated in the most physical language available, deliberately scandalous and not softened when the hearers object. Abiding as ingestion rather than as sentiment.

entries.pericope: This is a hard saying; many went back
entries.connection: Disciples leave over teaching rather than over persecution, and he lets them go without amending it. Peter's answer is not agreement but the absence of an alternative — to whom would we go — which is a more durable ground than enthusiasm.

entries.pericope: Even his brothers didn't believe in him
entries.connection: His brothers advise him to work publicly since no one seeking recognition acts in secret, and he goes up privately instead. The Hidden Life declining direct family pressure to make itself visible.

entries.pericope: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know
entries.connection: Willingness to obey is placed before understanding rather than after it, which reverses the order most people assume. The chapter then closes with the instruction not to judge by appearance, which is C07's whole argument in a sentence.

entries.pericope: Rivers of living water
entries.connection: Thirst is the only qualification named, and what is received becomes a source rather than a supply. Interior life described as overflowing outward by nature, not by additional effort.

entries.pericope: Does our law judge a man before it hears him?
entries.connection: Nicodemus intervenes not on the merits but on procedure — the man has not been heard — and is answered with an insult about his origins. Listening as Mercy stated as a legal principle, and refused.

entries.pericope: Neither do I condemn you
entries.connection: The accusers are turned to their own condition and leave from the eldest down, and the woman is neither condemned nor told that nothing happened. The Moral Audit and Merciful Reintegration performed in a single scene, with go and sin no more kept intact.

entries.pericope: If you remain in my word, the truth will make you free
entries.connection: Freedom is made the outcome of remaining rather than its precondition, and the bondage named is to sin rather than to any external power. Abiding stated as the mechanism by which a person stops being owned.

entries.pericope: Who sinned, this man or his parents?
entries.connection: The disciples propose a diagnosis before asking whether one is needed, and the premise is rejected outright. Interior Diagnosis has a boundary here: not every affliction has a moral root, and assuming one is its characteristic failure.

entries.pericope: One thing I know: I was blind, and now I see
entries.connection: Pressed twice by people with more standing, he refuses to speculate beyond what happened to him and is expelled for it. Testimony limited to experience, which turns out to be the hardest kind to overturn.

entries.pericope: If you were blind, you would have no sin
entries.connection: The chapter ends by inverting its own subject: the man born blind sees, and those certain of their sight are the ones who remain in it. C07's central claim, that sight is a moral condition rather than an optical one, argued to its sharpest point.

entries.pericope: The good shepherd and the hired hand
entries.connection: The hireling flees because the sheep are not his own, which locates the difference in ownership rather than in courage. Unobligated Loyalty given its clearest contrast: staying when nothing but the bond compels it.

entries.pericope: He stayed two days where he was
entries.connection: The delay is stated flatly and immediately after the statement that he loved them, so the two cannot be read against each other. Waiting that is neither indifference nor inability, and the text offers no relief from how it must have felt.

entries.pericope: Jesus wept
entries.connection: He groans, is troubled, and weeps at a grave he is about to open. Grief expressed fully in full knowledge that it will shortly be answered, which forecloses treating lament as something faith should have made unnecessary.

entries.pericope: The ointment poured out
entries.connection: An extravagance is defended against an objection framed in terms of the poor, and the objector's motive is named by the narrator rather than by Jesus. Attachment and its opposite shown at the same table.

entries.pericope: Unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies
entries.connection: Fruitfulness made conditional on a burial, with the alternative being remaining alone. The Discipline of Gradualism given its hardest image: the interval is not merely slow, it looks like loss while it lasts.

entries.pericope: They loved men's praise more than God's praise
entries.connection: Rulers who believed would not confess it, and the reason given is the weighing of two audiences. The Hidden Life inverted — belief kept secret for reputation rather than practice kept secret for God.

entries.pericope: He laid aside his outer garments and washed their feet
entries.connection: The passage states what he knew before he knelt — that the Father had given all things into his hands. The descent is made from full possession of status rather than from the absence of it, which is the distinction C16 draws between service and servility.
entries.review: PR17 added on synthesis review at medium confidence. He washes the feet of the one he knows will betray him and says only that not all are clean, signalling without naming. The enactment consists in what is withheld, which is weaker evidence than an act.

entries.pericope: I have given you an example
entries.connection: The act is turned immediately into an instruction, and the blessing is attached to doing rather than knowing. The clearest statement in the Gospels that the pattern of service is meant to be reproduced, not admired.

entries.pericope: He gave the morsel to the one who would betray him
entries.connection: Judas is handed food from the host's own hand — a gesture of honour — after his intent is already known. The refusal to return evil for evil, performed in the one moment where retaliation would have been universally excused.

entries.pericope: A new commandment: love one another as I have loved you
entries.connection: The identifying mark of the community is set as love among its members rather than doctrine, conduct, or separation. It is given as the visible sign by which outsiders will recognise them, which makes C15's architecture of peace a matter of witness and not only of comfort.

entries.pericope: The rooster will not crow until you have denied me three times
entries.connection: Peter's sincerity is not doubted and his failure is foretold in the same breath. Interior Diagnosis applied to a man who cannot yet see the root of his own confidence, and the foretelling is what makes his restoration possible later.

entries.pericope: I am the way, the truth, and the life
entries.connection: The way is identified with a person rather than with a method, which is the correction C09 makes to any reading of this road as technique. Thomas asks for directions and is given a relationship instead.

entries.pericope: We will come to him and make our home with him
entries.connection: Indwelling stated in both directions before the vine image gives it a picture. The same verb of making a home that C11 draws from John 1:14 returns here as something done in a person rather than among a people.

entries.pericope: Peace I leave with you, not as the world gives
entries.connection: Peace given as a possession rather than as a circumstance, and explicitly distinguished from the kind the world hands out. The quiet soul of C22 grounded in something received rather than achieved.

entries.pericope: I am the true vine; remain in me
entries.connection: The chapter this curriculum's eleventh takes its name from, and the passage that dismantles the error C11 exists to correct: apart from the vine you can do nothing, so transformation is not a load anyone pulls. Pruning is given to the branch that is already bearing, which forecloses reading hardship as evidence of failure.

entries.pericope: Remain in my love; no longer do I call you servants
entries.connection: Remaining is located in love rather than in effort, and the relation is renamed from servant to friend on the grounds of what has been disclosed. Unobligated Loyalty given its pattern: friendship that is chosen and then kept at cost.

entries.pericope: If the world hates you, it hated me first
entries.connection: Belonging elsewhere is named as the cause of friction with the world, without any instruction to withdraw from it. The Citizen-Stranger posture stated from the inside — chosen out of the world while still sent into it.

entries.pericope: The Spirit of truth will guide you into all truth
entries.connection: There are many things they cannot bear yet, and the withholding is presented as care rather than as concealment. The Discipline of Unknowing given a timeline: understanding arrives when it can be carried.

entries.pericope: Your sorrow will be turned into joy
entries.connection: Grief is not denied or shortened but given a shape — the woman in labour, whose anguish is real and then not remembered. Sacred Lament with its far side named, which is what keeps the practice from collapsing into despair.

entries.pericope: In the world you have oppression; but cheer up
entries.connection: Trouble is promised rather than warned against, and the scattering of the disciples is foretold in the same passage that offers them peace. Failure is written into the account in advance, which is the premise the recovery protocol rests on.

entries.pericope: This is eternal life, that they should know you
entries.connection: Eternal life defined as knowing rather than as duration. The whole road's destination stated as relationship, which is why C26 can treat transformation as illumination rather than as accumulation.

entries.pericope: Not that you take them from the world, but keep them from the evil one
entries.connection: Withdrawal explicitly declined in prayer. The Citizen-Stranger given its sharpest formulation — kept within the world rather than removed from it — which is the boundary the curriculum keeps against retreat.

entries.pericope: That they may all be one
entries.connection: Unity prayed for as the thing by which the world will know, which raises reconciliation from a private good to a public argument. The Architecture of Peace given its highest warrant.

entries.pericope: Put the sword into its sheath
entries.connection: Peter's violence is committed in defence of someone else and is still refused. Non-Retaliation held at the point where it is most defensible to abandon, and the request that the others be let go is made in the same breath.

entries.pericope: Peter warming himself at the fire of coals
entries.connection: The denial happens in three small conversational moments, none of them dramatic, while he is standing where it is warm. The failure has no crisis in it — which is the pattern Interior Diagnosis is built to catch.

entries.pericope: What is truth?
entries.connection: The question is asked by a man with the power to act on the answer, and he leaves before it is given. C07's claim that sight is a moral condition rather than an intellectual one, staged as an interrogation.

entries.pericope: The crown of thorns and the judgment seat
entries.connection: Authority is discussed by two men, one holding office and afraid, the other bound and not. The passage separates power from position so completely that Pilate's fear increases as his leverage is asserted.

entries.pericope: Behold your mother; it is finished
entries.connection: A domestic arrangement is made from the cross — who will take care of whom, and from what hour. The least glamorous obligation there is, attended to at the least ordinary moment available, which is precisely the collision C28 is built on.
entries.review: PR22 removed at review and PR23 substituted. PR22 is bearing with ungrateful behavior from those one is helping, which has nothing to do with this scene. The tag was assigned from the practice's name a third time.

entries.pericope: Joseph and Nicodemus take the body
entries.connection: Two men who had kept their allegiance hidden act only when there is nothing to gain and considerable to lose. The Hidden Life surfacing at the one moment when secrecy would have been safest.

entries.pericope: Mary at the tomb; he calls her by name
entries.connection: She is asked twice why she is weeping and is not told to stop. Recognition arrives through a single spoken name rather than through explanation, which is how C24 describes the landscape opening — not by argument.
entries.review: PR16 added on synthesis review. She is asked why she weeps and whom she seeks, and allowed to answer before anything is revealed — attention given before conclusion.

entries.pericope: As the Father has sent me, even so I send you
entries.connection: He comes to men who had abandoned him, says peace twice, and commissions them without a word of reproach. Merciful Reintegration performed on the whole group at once, and the authority to forgive is handed to the recently forgiven.

entries.pericope: Thomas, and those who have not seen
entries.connection: The demand for evidence is met rather than rebuked, and the blessing on those who did not see is added without withdrawing what was given to the one who did. Doubt handled as a condition to be treated rather than a fault to be shamed.

entries.pericope: Breakfast on the shore
entries.connection: After the resurrection they go back to work, catch nothing all night, and are given breakfast over a charcoal fire. The transformed life is shown taking place on an ordinary shore at dawn — the summit is behind them and they are living on a Tuesday, which is the claim C28 makes and had no Johannine anchor until here.

entries.pericope: Simon, do you love me? Feed my sheep
entries.connection: Three denials answered by three questions, over a charcoal fire like the one he stood at while denying. The restoration is specific to the failure and issues in a commission rather than a probation, which is the whole shape of the Failure Recovery Protocol.

entries.pericope: What is that to you? You follow me
entries.connection: Peter, just restored, immediately asks what will happen to someone else and is refused an answer. Comparison closed off as a category, which the Hidden Life depends on: faithfulness that is not measured against another person's road.

review_log.adjudication: PR22 corrected to PR23 on 19:17-30. Two gaps later added via the synthesis pass: PR17 on 13:1-11, PR16 on 20:1-18.
Clean pass, no changes. Whole-Gospel synthesis confirmed the abiding progression through chapters 6, 14, 15 and 17, and read the prediction note correctly including its retraction.
